blog_title: Benchmark Beaters Weekly: 40 Stocks Beating Their Benchmarks (September 30, 2026)
email_subject: Benchmark Beaters: MATR & MRNA lead 40 stocks beating the market
preview_text: 19 Canadian and 21 U.S. names at six-month relative highs. Full table and charts inside.
intro: The latest Benchmark Beaters screen (as of September 30, 2026) found 40 Canadian and U.S. stocks outperforming their benchmarks, each hitting a new six-month relative high in the last five trading days.

In Canada, 19 stocks made a fresh six-month high relative to the TSX Composite, 11 of them new to the list this week. Mattr Corp. (MATR) leads with a +136% six-month return, and Industrials is the most represented sector with 7 names.

In the U.S., 21 stocks made a fresh six-month high relative to the S&P 500, 10 of them new to the list this week. Moderna Inc. (MRNA) leads with a +286% six-month return, and Health Care is the most represented sector with 11 names.
